wth.text: Rath enters the story in Weatherlight when Captain Sisay is kidnapped and the crew must travel there to save her. The Weatherlight planeshifts to Rath and is ambushed and boarded by the Predator, whose crew take hostages, and Starke, who had bargained with Volrath for his daughter Takara's life, has helped deliver Sisay.
Under Greven il-Vec's command the Predator takes the Legacy artifacts, and Gerrard is knocked overboard in his duel with Greven. The moggs then break the Thran crystal, stranding the crew on Rath.

Volrath enslaves Starke as chamberlain and imprisons Takara, while Lyna and Ertai strike a bargain over the portal. The Weatherlight races to the portal Ertai holds open and escapes, leaving Ertai behind, and the Predator slams into the closing portal so that Ertai falls at Greven's feet.

tmp.text: In Tempest, Rath is revealed as an artificial plane built by Yawgmoth from flowstone as a staging point, hidden in a pocket plane where troops could be stored and the attack on Dominaria planned. Its evincars rule over the Kor, Vec, Dal and Skyshroud elves, putting down their revolts, while Volrath draws the Kor in along with other peoples.

Vuel is transported to Rath, gives himself to Phyrexia and becomes Volrath, evincar of Rath. The Vec are trapped by his will and divide into en-Vec and il-Vec, and the elves create the forest Skyshroud after their floating home is brought to Rath and their alliance with the merfolk ends in a bloody battle.

Volrath has Sisay abducted to lure the Weatherlight to Rath, ambushes it and captures Tahngarth, Karn and the Legacy artifacts, while Gerrard falls over Skyshroud Forest. Gerrard, proclaimed the Korvecdal, allies the crew with the elven rebels, who help them into the Stronghold.
Gerrard leads the Weatherlight to Rath, frees Sisay and retakes the Legacy from Volrath, and the crew escapes after Lyna tells Hanna that Ertai has prepared the portal off Rath.

sth.text: In Stronghold, Rath is a place that grows and feeds its ruler, with Volrath saying Rath grows and he is nourished. On Rath, Crovax sees Selenia leading an attack against the Weatherlight and breaks down, and he tears apart a shapeshifter in her guise inside the Stronghold.

Crovax strikes down Selenia, who shatters into shards that warp him into a vampire, and he kills Mirri after she follows him on deck. He defeats Greven and impales 6,000 hostages on flowstone spikes after failing against the Skyshroud rebels.

Greven il-Vec captures Ertai and takes him to the Stronghold, where Ertai secretly helps Crovax win a duel against Volrath after Crovax forces Belbe to name him evincar. Eladamri then kills Belbe and flees to Dominaria, leaving Ertai to submit to Crovax.

exo.text: In Exodus, a change comes over Crovax on Rath, whose bloodlust threatens the ship, while Ertai stands alone, focused on opening the arcane portal before his comrades return.

uds.text: Urza's Destiny describes Rath as a plane the Phyrexians created as a staging ground for their invasion. Urza creates the Metathran to resist the Rath overlay and Yawgmoth's coming invasion.

nem.text: Nemesis finds Rath in a brutal struggle over succession after Volrath abandoned his post as Evincar. Phyrexia chose Crovax to take Volrath's place and gave him new powers, while Rath's rebels united in Eladamri's name to break free of Phyrexia's tyranny.

Crovax rapidly outpaces his rivals, and Belbe, a Phyrexian emissary sent to oversee the contest, helps Eladamri and the last survivors escape to Dominaria. Crovax becomes undisputed Evincar and Volrath is executed, after which flowstone machinery resumes full operation and the Rathi overlay onto Dominaria begins.
Crovax has Ertai compleated, but Gerrard returns with Yawgmoth's boons and slices Crovax in half, and Selenia recovers his normal soul.

pls.text: In Planeshift, portions of Rath begin appearing in Dominaria, bringing Phyrexian reinforcements as Urza and Dominaria's armies lose.
Sisay crashes the Predator into Crovax's stronghold.

apc.text: In Apocalypse, the Weatherlight enters Rath's atmosphere to rescue Sisay, led by Gerrard, but Greven's Predator ambushes it and Vhati fires on the Weatherlight, sending Gerrard tumbling from the deck.

Ertai strikes a deal with the Soltari emissary Lyna to open the portal, and Squee accidentally activates the Salvation Sphere, driving off Volrath's undead attackers in the Death Pits. Mirri sacrifices herself fighting Crovax so Gerrard can escape.

The Weatherlight crosses the portal, leaving Ertai behind on Rath, and the Predator crashes into the portal, tumbling Ertai at Greven's feet and ending the assault. Despite rebel incursions led by Eladamri and Liin Sivi, the Stronghold stays in control of Rath until the overlay, which disrupts magic and produces the Volvers.
